title: Moonshot AI launches Kimi K2.6 on Kimi Chat and APIs
raw_excerpt: Kimi K2.6 features robust capabilities for coding and agentic tasks across chat and agent modes on kimi.com, with weights on Hugging Face and APIs via platform.moonshot.ai. The lineup includes K2.6 Instant for quick replies, K2.6 Thinking for complex reasoning, K2.6 Agent for document and web tasks, and K2.6 Agent Swarm for large-scale processing. Kimi K2.6 claims top open-source benchmark scores, surpassing competitors like GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 in SWE-bench Multilingual and BrowseComp.
summary: 月之暗面发布Kimi K2.6，这是其最新开源模型，在SWE-bench Multilingual和BrowseComp等基准上超越GPT-5.4和Claude Opus 4.6。模型提供Instant、Thinking、Agent、Agent Swarm四种模式，覆盖快速响应、复杂推理、文档/网页任务及大规模处理场景。权重已开源至Hugging Face，API可通过platform.moonshot.ai调用。此举标志着开源模型在编码和智能体任务上达到新高度。

title: SpaceX says it has agreement to acquire Cursor for $60B
summary: SpaceX宣布已与AI编程工具Cursor达成协议，有权以600亿美元收购Cursor，或支付100亿美元作为合作补偿。作为交换，SpaceX将提供xAI的Colossus超算系统中的数万张英伟达GPU，用于训练Cursor下一代自研模型Composer 2.5。这是AI编程领域迄今最大规模的算力合作，也标志着马斯克将算力转化为可出租的云服务。

title: Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents
raw_excerpt: Google has introduced Deep Research and Deep Research Max, leveraging the Gemini 3.1 Pro model to enhance autonomous research capabilities.
summary: Google推出Deep Research和Deep Research Max，基于Gemini 3.1 Pro模型，大幅提升自主研究能力。Deep Research Max能执行多步骤、跨来源的深度调研，生成结构化报告。该工具面向需要复杂信息综合的专业用户，如分析师、学者和决策者，标志着AI研究代理从简单搜索向深度推理的跃迁。

title: OpenAI develops platform for always-on Agents on ChatGPT
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is developing an always-on agent platform within ChatGPT, codenamed Hermes, that allows users to create and continuously run custom agents. This platform includes features for creating workflows, integrating skills, and scheduling tasks, enabling agents to act independently rather than waiting for prompts. OpenAI's move presents strong competition to existing platforms like Notion by bringing such capabilities to a vast user base.
summary: OpenAI正在开发代号为Hermes的始终在线智能体平台，集成于ChatGPT中。用户可创建自定义智能体，设置工作流、集成技能并安排任务，使其无需等待提示即可自主运行。此举直接对标Notion等平台，将智能体能力带给数亿用户，可能重新定义个人生产力工具。

title: Introducing OpenAI Privacy Filter
raw_excerpt: OpenAI Privacy Filter is an open-weight model for detecting and redacting personally identifiable information (PII) in text with state-of-the-art accuracy
summary: OpenAI发布Privacy Filter，一款开源权重模型，用于检测和脱敏文本中的个人身份信息（PII），达到业界领先精度。该模型可集成到各类应用中，帮助企业在处理用户数据时满足隐私法规要求。这是OpenAI在负责任AI方向的重要产品，为数据安全提供了可部署的解决方案。

title: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview brings stronger world knowledge and instruction following along with significant agentic coding improvements across a wide range of benchmarks. The model is still under active development as researchers continue to iterate on it. Users can chat with the model interactively in Qwen Studio or call via API on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API (coming soon).
summary: 阿里通义千问发布Qwen3.6-Max-Preview，在知识广度、指令遵循和智能体编码能力上显著提升，多项基准表现优异。该模型仍在积极迭代中，用户可通过Qwen Studio交互体验或通过阿里云模型服务API调用。这是Qwen系列持续进化的最新成果，巩固了其在大模型开源生态中的领先地位。

title: Modular Post-Training
raw_excerpt: AllenAI describes a post-training approach that builds independent domain experts and combines them using a mixture-of-experts architecture. This allows models to gain new capabilities without retraining from scratch or degrading existing skills.
summary: AllenAI提出模块化后训练方法BAR，通过构建独立领域专家并使用混合专家架构组合，使模型获得新能力而无需从头训练或损害已有技能。该方法解决了传统微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，为高效、可扩展的模型能力增强提供了新范式，对多领域AI系统开发具有重要参考价值。

title: CrabTrap: an LLM-as-a-judge HTTP proxy to secure agents in production
raw_excerpt: CrabTrap is an open-source HTTP/HTTPS proxy that intercepts every request an AI agent makes and uses LLM-as-a-judge to determine if the request matches a policy of allowed traffic for that agent. Agents need real credentials, but can hallucinate destructive actions or get prompt-injected. This can have production consequences. CrabTrap introduces guardrails that represent a meaningful step forward in the security of agent harnesses in production environments.
summary: Brex开源CrabTrap，一个基于LLM-as-a-judge的HTTP/HTTPS代理，可拦截AI代理发出的每个请求，并根据策略判断是否允许。它能有效防止代理因幻觉或提示注入而执行破坏性操作，为生产环境中的代理安全提供了关键防护层。这是代理安全领域的重要开源贡献。

title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.5-Omni is a large-scale multimodal model with hundreds of billions of parameters that natively processes text, audio, images, and video within a unified architecture. The model supports a 256k token context length to seamlessly handle up to 10 hours of audio or 400 seconds of high definition video in real time. It leverages a Hybrid Attention Mixture of Experts framework alongside a dynamic alignment technique called ARIA to generate highly stable and emotionally nuanced multilingual speech synthesis with minimal latency.
summary: Qwen3.5-Omni技术报告发布，该模型拥有数千亿参数，采用混合MoE架构，原生支持文本、音频、图像和视频多模态输入，支持256K token上下文长度，可实时处理10小时音频或400秒高清视频。其动态对齐技术ARIA能生成高稳定、富有情感的多语言语音。这是多模态大模型的重要进展。

title: QIMMA قِمّة ⛰: A Quality-First Arabic LLM Leaderboard
summary: TII推出QIMMA（قمة）阿拉伯语LLM排行榜，采用质量优先的评估方法，专注于阿拉伯语大模型的性能排名。该榜单填补了阿拉伯语AI评估的空白，为阿拉伯语NLP研究提供了标准化基准，有助于推动低资源语言大模型的发展。
